format: gzip of UTF-8 newline-delimited GeoJSON Features; no record separator
coordinateSystem: WGS84 longitude/latitude; original double coordinates, no rounding
selectionPolicy: Keep original building or building_part geometry if it intersects Seoul; do not physically cut boundary-crossing footprints or remove holes.
districtPolicy: Representative interior point if covered by a district; boundary-crossing fallback uses greatest intersection area. Exactly one district per retained feature.
heightPolicy: height and min_height are unmodified optional source values in metres, NOT independently surveyed. Missing height is explicit null, not 0 and not a fabricated estimate. No floor multiplier applied.
geometryPolicy: All source Polygon/MultiPolygon exterior/interior rings preserved. No repair or simplification. Invalid source geometry is flagged and needs an explicitly documented rendering policy.
propertyPolicy: Original non-null properties retained; null height/min_height retained explicitly. sources array retained with only null-valued fields omitted. Arrow map-valued fields use their original list-of-pairs representation.
buildingPartsPolicy: building_part carries original building_id; parts and parent outlines both preserved. Renderer must avoid double-extruding covered parent footprints.
